disposition: SUITABLE FOR FURTHER IMPLEMENTATION DESIGN WITH CONDITIONS
authority_limit: This is an advisory design review, NOT independent operational B1 acceptance, source authentication, a trusted authority signature, or permission to provision/start the runtime.
findings: Historical isolation is conceptually acceptable, but independent acceptance of exclusions and unresolved legacy obligations remains required.

Proposed $1,000 hypothetical capital, MSFT-only, manual-entry, long-only, $100 maximum entry notional and one-position scope are suitable for further engineering design, subject to operator confirmation and enforcement.
Proposed 2bps fees and 2bps slippage per side are internally consistent synthetic assumptions, not authenticated market costs.
Physical resource identity, actual writer exclusion, durable receipts and shutdown ownership require separate native evidence and acceptance.
Legitimate overnight Quality Dips positions must remain open. Clean shutdown must not imply liquidation; incomplete valuation or UNKNOWN operations must remain explicit.
ChatGPT cannot authenticate the original historical archive, independently certify protected Windows resources or issue operational startup authority.
